item.title: Busan Station to Taejongdae by Bus: Take 17, 88 or 101 (About 40 Min), or 30 Min from Nampo-dong
item.description: It’s bus 17, 88 or 101. Come out of Exit 7 at Busan Station (부산역), go to the stop across from the Kyowon Building (교원빌딩), and take whichever of the three comes first. Get off at “Taejongdae” (태종대) or at the last stop, “Taejongdae Oncheon” (태종대온천). The ride takes about 40 minutes. Taejongdae has no subway station, so wherever you start, the last leg is a bus. (Busan Infrastructure Corporation’s directions to Taejongdae Resort Park, checked November 28, 2026.)

item.title: Taejongdae Danubi Train 2026: Suspended, Free Shuttle Bus (Wed–Sun 09:30–17:30), Parking & How to Get There
item.description: Taejongdae (태종대) is free to enter. The Danubi Train (다누비열차) is not running right now because of a safety inspection, and a free loop bus runs in its place from Wednesday to Sunday, 09:30–17:30. On Mondays and Tuesdays the bus is off too. From Busan Station (부산역) it is about 40 minutes on bus 17, 88 or 101, and about 30 minutes from Nampo-dong (남포동). Everything below is from the websites of the Busan Tourism Organization, which runs the Danubi Train, and the Busan Infrastructure Corporation, which manages the park, checked on November 28, 2026.
